fileErrors.CORRUPTED: This file is damaged and cannot be opened.

fileErrors.LOCAL_COPY_FAILED: The project could not be kept on this computer. Check the free space on your disk, or use Save as to choose a file.
fileErrors.TOO_COMPLEX: This file is too complex to be opened safely.

app.name: Tasklace
app.tagline: Plan a project on a Gantt chart, alone or together.

status.conflictsHint: A person or team has two tasks at the same time.

notices.label: Messages

repairs.one: {count} change was adjusted to keep the project valid.
repairs.other: {count} changes were adjusted to keep the project valid.

notices.localCopyFailed: The project was saved to its file, but its copy on this computer could not be written. Check the free space on your disk.
notices.recentUnavailable: The list of recent projects could not be read. Your projects were not changed.
notices.unexpectedError: Something went wrong and the last action did not finish. Try again; if it keeps happening, save your project under another name.
notices.pickerUnavailable: The calendar could not open. Type the date instead, such as 2026-10-05 14:30.

drawingUnavailable.timeline: The timeline cannot be drawn on this computer. You can still plan your tasks in the table.
drawingUnavailable.patterns: The patterns of the bars cannot be drawn on this computer, so tags of close colors may look alike. Check the tag legend.

notices.undoFailed: This change cannot be undone any more, because it no longer fits the project as it is now. Nothing was changed.
notices.redoFailed: This change cannot be redone any more, because it no longer fits the project as it is now. Nothing was changed.
notices.scheduleStopped: The schedule could not be updated, so the dates shown may be out of date. Your changes are kept; make another change to try again, and if this message comes back, save your project and restart Tasklace.

exportFailed.SCHEDULE_MISMATCH: The table could not be written while the schedule was being updated. Try again.
exportFailed.UNKNOWN_BLOCK: The table could not be written: a link names a block its task does not have. Check the links of the split tasks.

notices.projectStartMoved: The project now starts on {date}, so that this task can start earlier.

scheduleFailures.calendar: The schedule could not be computed because the working calendar of the project is not valid.
scheduleFailures.startDate: The schedule could not be computed because the start date of the project is outside the supported years.
scheduleFailures.structure: The schedule could not be computed because the plan contains an error.
scheduleFailures.task: The schedule could not be computed because the task “{name}” cannot be placed.

table.label: Tasks
table.name: Name
table.pickDate: Choose the {column} of {name} on a calendar

tasks.label: Task
tasks.indent: Indent: put under the task above
tasks.outdent: Outdent: move out of its summary
tasks.milestone: Turn into a milestone, a key date with no duration, or back into a task

editErrors.NOT_POSSIBLE: This change is not possible here.
editErrors.INVALID_DURATION: Write the duration in hours, such as 14 or 1 h 30, in minutes, such as 45 min, or in working days, such as 2d.
editErrors.INVALID_DATE: This date could not be read. Write it as 2026-10-05, or as 2026-10-05 14:30 with a time. Times go by quarter hours.
editErrors.INVALID_PROGRESS: Write the progress as a whole number from 0 to 100.
editErrors.INVALID_PREDECESSORS: Write the predecessors by task number, such as 1.2, 3SS+2h, or 3#2 for block 2 of task 3, each one once.
editErrors.UNKNOWN_BLOCK: The task you named has no block with this number. Blocks are counted from 1, on split tasks only.
editErrors.LINKS_WOULD_MERGE: Two different links of this task would become the same link. Remove one of them first.
editErrors.WAITS_NEED_TWO_BLOCKS: This task has a single block, so it cannot wait block by block. Write what it waits for in Predecessors.
editErrors.TASK_CHANGED: This task changed while its details were open. Close them and open them again.
editErrors.SCHEDULE_PENDING: The dates are still being updated after the last change. Try again in a moment.
editErrors.SCHEDULE_STOPPED: The dates could not be updated after the last change. Change a value in the table to compute them again, then try again.
editErrors.INVALID_TIME: This time could not be read. Write it as 08:30. Times go by quarter hours.
editErrors.NO_ROOM_FOR_RANGE: There is no room left in the day for more working hours. Make the latest range end earlier first.
editErrors.DUPLICATE_TAG_NAME: Another tag already has this name.
editErrors.TOO_MANY_TAGS: A project can have at most 256 tags. Delete a tag you no longer use first.
editErrors.UNKNOWN_TASK_NUMBER: There is no task with this number.
editErrors.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: This link would make tasks wait for each other in a loop.
editErrors.SUMMARY_DEPENDENCY: Summary tasks cannot be linked. Link the tasks inside them.
editErrors.SELF_DEPENDENCY: A task cannot be linked to itself.
editErrors.HIERARCHY_TOO_DEEP: Tasks cannot be nested this deeply.
editErrors.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: The project has reached its maximum size.
editErrors.OUT_OF_RANGE: This value is outside the allowed range.
editErrors.INVALID_END: A task has to end after it starts.
editErrors.INVALID_BLOCK: Write the duration of each block, such as 4 h or 1 h 30.
editErrors.INVALID_GAP: Write the days between two blocks as a whole number, 0 for the same day.
editErrors.INVALID_HOURS_PER_DAY: Hours per day go from 1 hour to the length of a working day, by quarter hours.
editErrors.INVALID_DAILY_START: Write the daily start time as 13:30, on a quarter hour, leaving enough working hours after it.

details.title: Task details
details.name: Name
details.startHint: Leave empty to start as soon as possible.
details.hoursPerDayHint: Leave empty to work the whole working day.
details.dailyStartHint: Leave empty to start at the first working hour of each day.
details.blocksHint: Split the task into several blocks to pause it and resume it later. A block can wait for other tasks, or for a block of them written 3#2 (block 2 of task 3).
details.milestoneHint: A milestone marks a key date with no duration, such as a delivery or an approval. Link tasks to it to show what they lead to or wait for.

closePrompt.title: Save this project?
closePrompt.body: This project has not been saved to a file yet. Save it before closing it, or its changes will be lost.
closePrompt.failedTitle: The project could not be saved
closePrompt.failedBody: Its latest changes could not be written: {reason} Save it under another name, close without saving, or cancel to keep it open.

issues.INVALID_JSON: The file is not valid JSON.
issues.INVALID_CSV: The table could not be read: check the quotes and separators.
issues.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This is not a Tasklace project.
issues.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This file comes from a newer version of Tasklace.
issues.UNKNOWN_FIELD: This value is not part of a Tasklace project.
issues.WRONG_TYPE: This value has the wrong kind, such as text where a number is expected.
issues.OUT_OF_RANGE: This value is outside the allowed range.
issues.INVALID_TEXT: This text contains characters that are not allowed.
issues.INVALID_DATE: This date could not be read.
issues.INVALID_COLOR: This color is not valid. Colors are written as #RRGGBB.
issues.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: This list has more entries than allowed.
issues.TOO_MANY_ISSUES: There are more problems than can be listed; only the first ones are shown.
issues.DUPLICATE_ENTRY: This entry appears more than once.
issues.TOO_MANY_REPAIRS: The project needed too many corrections to be read safely.
issues.INVALID_NOTATION: This notation could not be read, such as 1.2FS+4h for a predecessor or 3h; +1d 2h for blocks.
issues.INVALID_NUMBER: This number could not be read.
issues.UNSUPPORTED_UNIT: This column uses a unit Tasklace does not know: durations go in hours and progress in %.
issues.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: This refers to a task number that does not exist.
issues.DURATION_MISMATCH: The duration does not match the sum of the blocks.
issues.UNSCHEDULABLE: The project could not be scheduled.
issues.NO_WORKING_WEEKDAY: The calendar needs at least one working day.
issues.INVALID_WEEKDAY: This day of the week is not valid.
issues.DUPLICATE_WEEKDAY: This working day appears more than once.
issues.NO_WORKING_TIME_RANGE: The calendar needs at least one range of working hours.
issues.TOO_MANY_WORKING_TIME_RANGES: The calendar has more ranges of working hours than allowed.
issues.INVALID_WORKING_TIME_RANGE: This range of working hours is not valid: it has to end after it starts, by quarter hours.
issues.OVERLAPPING_WORKING_TIME_RANGES: These ranges of working hours overlap.
issues.TOO_MANY_NON_WORKING_PERIODS: The calendar has more days off than allowed.
issues.INVALID_NON_WORKING_PERIOD: This period off is not valid: it has to end on or after the day it starts.
issues.INVALID_HOURS_PER_DAY: The hours per day of this task are not valid: from 1 hour to the length of the working day.
issues.INVALID_DAILY_START_HOUR: The daily start of this task does not leave enough working hours in the day.
issues.TOO_MANY_TASKS: The project has more tasks than allowed.
issues.TOO_MANY_DEPENDENCIES: The project has more links than allowed.
issues.TOO_MANY_TAGS: The project has more tags than allowed.
issues.DUPLICATE_TASK_ID: Two tasks have the same identifier.
issues.DUPLICATE_DEPENDENCY_ID: Two links have the same identifier.
issues.DUPLICATE_TAG_ID: Two tags have the same identifier.
issues.UNKNOWN_PARENT: This task is placed under a task that does not exist.
issues.PARENT_NOT_SUMMARY: This task is placed under a task that is not a summary.
issues.HIERARCHY_CYCLE: These tasks are placed under each other in a loop.
issues.HIERARCHY_TOO_DEEP: Tasks are nested more deeply than allowed.
issues.INVALID_DURATION: This duration is not valid: it goes by quarter hours, up to the maximum allowed.
issues.INVALID_HOURS: This number of hours is not valid: it goes by quarter hours.
issues.INVALID_LAG: This delay is not valid: it goes by quarter hours, up to the maximum allowed.
issues.INVALID_SEGMENTS: The blocks of this task are not valid.
issues.INVALID_INSTANT: This date is outside the dates Tasklace can plan.
issues.INVALID_INTERVAL: This period ends before it starts.
issues.BEYOND_PLANNING_HORIZON: The project would end after the last date Tasklace can plan.
issues.SELF_DEPENDENCY: A task cannot be linked to itself.
issues.SUMMARY_DEPENDENCY: Summary tasks cannot be linked. Link the tasks inside them.
issues.UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY_TASK: This link points to a task that does not exist.
issues.DUPLICATE_DEPENDENCY: These tasks are linked more than once.
issues.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: These links make tasks wait for each other in a loop.
issues.UNKNOWN_BLOCK: This link names a block the task does not have.
issues.UNKNOWN_COLUMN: This column is not one Tasklace knows; it was ignored.
issues.EXTRA_CELLS: This row has more cells than there are columns; the extra cells were ignored.
issues.IGNORED_VALUE: This value does not apply to this kind of task and was ignored.
issues.IGNORED_LINKS: A summary task cannot wait for other tasks; these links were ignored.
issues.START_DIFFERS: The start was moved to follow the links and the calendar.
issues.END_DIFFERS: The end was recalculated from the start, the duration and the calendar.
issues.PROGRESS_DIFFERS: The progress of a summary task is computed from its tasks; the value given was ignored.

repairCodes.TASK_REMOVED: A task was removed because the project had too many tasks.
repairCodes.DEPENDENCY_REMOVED: A link was removed because it was a duplicate, made a loop, linked a task to itself, involved a task that was deleted or became a summary, or the project had too many links.
repairCodes.BLOCK_LINK_CLEARED: A link to a block that no longer exists now points to the whole task.
repairCodes.TAG_REMOVED: A tag was removed because the project had too many tags.
repairCodes.TAG_CLEARED: A task lost its tag because the tag was deleted.
repairCodes.MOVED_TO_ROOT: A task was moved to the top level because its place in the outline was no longer possible.
repairCodes.HOURS_PER_DAY_REDUCED: The hours per day of a task were reduced to the length of the working day.
repairCodes.DAILY_START_HOUR_CLEARED: The daily start of a task was cleared because it left too few working hours.
repairCodes.MILESTONE_PROGRESS_ROUNDED: The progress of a milestone was set to 0 % or 100 %.

settings.title: Project settings
settings.undoHint: Each change applies at once. Undo it with Ctrl+Z.
settings.projectStartHint: No task starts before this date and time. New tasks start here.

tasksMoved.one: The new project start moved {count} task.
tasksMoved.other: The new project start moved {count} tasks.

settings.noDaysOff: No days off yet. Public holidays are not added automatically: add each day off here.
settings.periodLast: Last day off of period {number}, empty for a single day
settings.addPeriod: Add a day or a period off
settings.hoursPerDayTooLong: “{name}” works {hours} per day, more than the new working day. Lower its hours per day first, or keep a longer working day.
settings.dailyStartTooLate: “{name}” starts its days at {time}, which leaves too few working hours in the new working day. Change its daily start first, or keep a longer working day.
settings.noTags: No tags yet. A tag gives its tasks their color. A tag that represents a person or a team also warns you when that person or team has two tasks at the same time.
settings.patterned: Tags with a pattern have a color close to another tag: the pattern keeps their bars apart.
settings.indistinct: “{name}” cannot be told apart from some other tags: too many tags have a color close to it. Choose another color for it.

deleteBody.one: {count} task uses it. That task keeps its dates and will have no tag. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.
deleteBody.other: {count} tasks use it. They keep their dates and will have no tag. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.

report.fileFailed: Why the file could not be read
report.saveFailed: Why the open project could not be saved
report.scheduleFailed: Why the schedule could not be computed

startup.failedBody: Tasklace stopped while starting. Your projects were not changed. Try opening it again; if it keeps happening, restart your computer.

pageProblems.crashedBody: Your project is saved automatically a few seconds after your last change, so only the changes made since then may be lost. Reload the window, then reopen your project from the recent projects, or close it.
pageProblems.crashedWithoutFileBody: This project has no file yet, so it cannot be reopened after the window reloads, and its changes are lost. Reload the window to go on working, or close it.
pageProblems.crashedWithoutProjectBody: No project was open, so nothing was lost. Reload the window to go on working, or close it.
pageProblems.startFailedBody: The window could not start. Your projects were not changed. Reload it to try again, or close it.
pageProblems.unresponsiveBody: It stopped responding while saving your project before closing. Wait a little longer, or close it now: changes not saved yet would be lost.
